canonical:
glassbox-canonical 1
version 2
id "elevator"
title "Elevator"
clock seconds
initial "idle"
notes 26
  note "Written to try to BREAK the format, not to flatter it. The looper and the"
  note "car radio were both authored by whoever designed the format, so of course"
  note "they fitted. An elevator is the first machine that pushes back."
  note ""
  note "The thing it pushes on is floors. A twelve-storey lift plainly has more to"
  note "it than a three-storey one, but 'which floor am I on' is NOT a mode: the"
  note "lift behaves identically on floor 2 and floor 7, and making each floor a"
  note "state would give twelve copies of one machine and an unreadable drawing."
  note ""
  note "So the floor number lives in the HOST, and reaches the machine as facts —"
  note "is anything requested above me, below me, here. That is how real lift"
  note "controllers are written, and the format's own sorting test agrees: change"
  note "the current floor and the diagram does not move, so it is not part of the"
  note "machine. Change 'doors need holding' and it does."
  note ""
  note "The cost is that a designer has to know to do this, and nothing in the"
  note "format tells them. That is a finding, not a defect."
  note ""
  note "It pushed back a second time over commands, and taught the same lesson in"
  note "a different key. The obvious move is 'leaving doors-open closes the"
  note "doors' — and it is wrong, because doors-open is adjacent to doors-held,"
  note "which wants them left open. Doors are closed on ENTRY to each of the"
  note "states that require them shut instead. The general rule the corpus keeps"
  note "arriving at: entry commands say what must now be true and compose safely;"
  note "exit commands are only safe for something no neighbouring state can want,"
  note "which here is exactly one thing — the alarm."
states 7
  state "arriving" "Arriving" false (entry 2 "stop-drive" "ring-arrival") (exit 0)
  state "doors-open" "Doors open" false (entry 1 "open-doors") (exit 0)
  state "down" "Going down" false (entry 2 "close-doors" "drive-down") (exit 0)
  state "held" "Doors held" false (entry 1 "hold-doors") (exit 0)
  state "idle" "Idle" false (entry 2 "close-doors" "hold-brake") (exit 0)
  state "stopped" "Emergency stop" false (entry 2 "stop-drive" "sound-alarm") (exit 1 "cancel-alarm")
  state "up" "Going up" false (entry 2 "close-doors" "drive-up") (exit 0)
events 7
  event "alarm" "emergency stop" user
  event "call" "call" user
  event "close" "close doors" user
  event "dwelt" "dwell elapsed" runtime
  event "open" "open doors" user
  event "reached" "floor reached" runtime
  event "reset" "reset" user
config 2
  config "dwell-seconds" "Doors stay open for (s)" (num 6)
  config "has-hold-button" "This car has a hold button" (bool true)
facts 3
  fact "doors-blocked" "Something is in the doorway"
  fact "wanted-above" "A floor above is requested"
  fact "wanted-below" "A floor below is requested"
refusals 5
  refusal "blocked" "something is in the doorway"
  refusal "moving" "the car is moving"
  refusal "no-hold-button" "this car has no hold button"
  refusal "nowhere-to-go" "no floor is requested"
  refusal "stopped-fast" "the emergency stop is engaged"
commands 10
  command "cancel-alarm" "Silence the alarm"
  command "close-doors" "Close the doors"
  command "drive-down" "Drive the car down"
  command "drive-up" "Drive the car up"
  command "hold-brake" "Set the parking brake"
  command "hold-doors" "Hold the doors open"
  command "open-doors" "Open the doors"
  command "ring-arrival" "Ring the arrival chime"
  command "sound-alarm" "Sound the alarm"
  command "stop-drive" "Stop the drive"
rules 49
  rule "arriving" "alarm" (cases 1 (case - (move "stopped")))
  rule "arriving" "call" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "arriving" "close" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "arriving" "dwelt" (cases 1 (case - (move "doors-open")))
  rule "arriving" "open" (cases 1 (case - (move "doors-open")))
  rule "arriving" "reached" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "arriving" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "doors-open" "alarm" (cases 1 (case - (move "stopped")))
  rule "doors-open" "call" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "doors-open" "close" (cases 4 (case (holds (fact "doors-blocked")) (refuse "blocked")) (case (holds (fact "wanted-above")) (move "up")) (case (holds (fact "wanted-below")) (move "down")) (case - (move "idle")))
  rule "doors-open" "dwelt" (cases 4 (case (holds (fact "doors-blocked")) (stay)) (case (holds (fact "wanted-above")) (move "up")) (case (holds (fact "wanted-below")) (move "down")) (case - (move "idle")))
  rule "doors-open" "open" (cases 2 (case (not (holds (config "has-hold-button"))) (refuse "no-hold-button")) (case - (move "held")))
  rule "doors-open" "reached" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "doors-open" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "down" "alarm" (cases 1 (case - (move "stopped")))
  rule "down" "call" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "down" "close" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "down" "dwelt" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "down" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "moving")))
  rule "down" "reached" (cases 1 (case - (move "arriving")))
  rule "down" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "held" "alarm" (cases 1 (case - (move "stopped")))
  rule "held" "call" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "held" "close" (cases 1 (case - (move "doors-open")))
  rule "held" "dwelt" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "held" "open" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "held" "reached" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "held" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "idle" "alarm" (cases 1 (case - (move "stopped")))
  rule "idle" "call" (cases 3 (case (holds (fact "wanted-above")) (move "up")) (case (holds (fact "wanted-below")) (move "down")) (case - (refuse "nowhere-to-go")))
  rule "idle" "close" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "idle" "dwelt" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "idle" "open" (cases 1 (case - (move "doors-open")))
  rule "idle" "reached" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "idle" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "stopped" "alarm" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "stopped" "call" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "stopped-fast")))
  rule "stopped" "close" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "stopped-fast")))
  rule "stopped" "dwelt" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "stopped" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "stopped-fast")))
  rule "stopped" "reached" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "stopped" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (move "doors-open")))
  rule "up" "alarm" (cases 1 (case - (move "stopped")))
  rule "up" "call" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "up" "close" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "up" "dwelt" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "up" "open" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "moving")))
  rule "up" "reached" (cases 1 (case - (move "arriving")))
  rule "up" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
deadlines 1
  deadline "doors-open" "dwelt" (config "dwell-seconds")
